crossRefs.note: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much…
Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink…
He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

parallels.note: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink…
He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

translations.web: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
translations.bsb: Again He went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
translations.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
translations.asv: And again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
